map.name: Zorreth
map.trouble: The renegade sorcerer Maldrek has sent his Gargoyles and Imps against the College of Zorreth, seized the Observatory and taken the Archmage Brannoch prisoner.

guard_bark.specifics: Gorvo, guard at the college gate of Zorreth.

first.speaker: Gorvo
first.text: We don't see many travelers at the gate these days.

again.speaker: Gorvo
again.text: Hey who left the gate unlatched?

later.speaker: Gorvo
later.text: Oh, bless you. That was a bold thing to do.

bounty_offer.specifics: Tessik, keeper of the Archive, wants the Imps and giant bats cleared from the vaults and his trapped clerks rescued.

offer.speaker: Tessik
offer.text:
Why are you so late!? We are in terrible trouble!

Vicious giant bats and Imps from the pit have overrun the vaults beneath the Archive. Several clerks have been lost protecting the college's precious books!

Please, we implore you! Drive the beasts from the vaults, rescue my clerks and I will pay you generously.

This key opens the gate to the first trapped clerk. He will lead you to the others.

I also have a spell book which ought to be very handy.

reminder.speaker: Tessik
reminder.text: Come back to me when you have freed my clerks and I will pay you well.

completion.speaker: Tessik
completion.text:
You are truly a hero! My sincere thanks.

As you were saving my clerks down below, the Captain stopped by, asking after you. He's waiting at the Lower Gate -- south of here.

Before you leave, here is some gold for your trouble.

journal.text: Slay or banish all the beasts in the vaults. Rescue the 4 trapped clerks.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Dorrick's Cloak of Warding, woven by his colleague Yarnak, was carried off by the Gargoyles to the ruined bell tower.

offer.speaker: Dorrick
offer.text:
While I look into what is troubling our college, there's another job that needs doing.

Yarnak, a colleague of mine, finished the Cloak of Warding I asked for, but the Gargoyles carried it off from his cottage.

Beyond the college wall there is a ruined bell tower where the Gargoyles roost. They carry everything they steal up there. You may leave by the garden door at the back of this hall.

Please fetch my cloak back and let Yarnak know it is safe.

Will you help me, Apprentice?

refusal.speaker: Dorrick
refusal.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Think it over and come back.

reminder.speaker: Dorrick
reminder.text: Go to the bell tower and find my cloak! Now!

completion.speaker: Dorrick
completion.text:
You found the Cloak of Warding! Excellent!

Sadly, my worst fears for Yarnak's cottage have come true. I shall miss his fine work, but we have no time for sorrow, I'm afraid. The Gate Wardens need my help and Rector Ulbrin asks for your assistance.

Please take this potion. Good luck!

after.speaker: Dorrick
after.text: Thanks again for finding my cloak!

journal.text: Retrieve the Cloak of Warding which the Gargoyles stole from Yarnak.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve the Cloak of Warding which the Gargoyles stole from Yarnak.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk: Fenn on the Observatory, Tessik on Pellam's lost wits, Hendry brushing the player off.

rumour1.speaker: Fenn
rumour1.text: Maldrek must have found some way past our wards. At noon the Observatory was quiet, by dusk it was swarming with Gargoyles and Imps! They want the Orrery.

rumour2.speaker: Tessik
rumour2.text: I'm afraid Pellam finally lost his wits. They've given me his study since he's taken to roaming the cloisters honking like a goose and chasing pigeons.

rumour3.speaker: Hendry
rumour3.text: Shouldn't you be out chasing Gargoyles?

shop_greeting.specifics: Pippet of the Singed Quill inn, Hobb the smith, Varna the magic seller.

inn.speaker: Pippet
inn.text: Dark days, lad. I can't believe Maldrek turned on the college. Dire news indeed! Better rest up while you can!

arms.speaker: Hobb
arms.text: Welcome to Hobb's Iron and Steel. I believe I still have a few good blades in stock.

magic.speaker: Varna
magic.text: Hello, kind sir. I'm nearly ready to pack up and leave town. Everything must go, if you're interested.

two_givers.specifics: Hendry offers a bounty on Zigg Quickquill, dead or alive, and Zigg offers to surrender; Gorvo pays for the capture, Hendry for the kill.

offer_a.speaker: Hendry
offer_a.text:
Good day, young sir. I gather you have come about the bounty.

There's a fat bounty on Zigg Quickquill -- dead or alive. He and his sorry gang of dropouts have been raiding our fair college's libraries for weeks.

Watch yourself, you don't want to be caught napping by those rowdy scoundrels.

offer_b.speaker: Zigg Quickquill
offer_b.text: I give up! Don't zap me, please! I'll come along without a fuss!

outcome_a.speaker: Gorvo
outcome_a.text:
Hold it! The gardener heard odd noises coming from here, so I came to look.

You have caught the notorious Zigg Quickquill all by yourself! Very impressive! You have my deepest respect! Quickquill's gang has plagued Zorreth for weeks! I'll handle him from here. We will all sleep easier with this wretched rascal in the cellar!

And now for your reward -- 200 in gold!

outcome_b.speaker: Hendry
outcome_b.text:
So you killed Zigg, eh? Well, I wanted him brought in alive, but I won't be losing any sleep over it!

Take your reward -- 100 in gold! Thanks for cleaning up our streets!

journal_a.text: Bring in Zigg Quickquill, dead or alive.

journal_b.text: Take Zigg Quickquill in to the town guard.

rescue.specifics: The Captain begs the player to rescue the Archmage Brannoch, taken by Maldrek's Gargoyles to Spire Crag.

plea.speaker: Captain
plea.text:
Blast! What kept you, lad!? The Gargoyles stormed Zorreth and we'd have lost the college to them if Brannoch's mighty sorcery had not rallied us at the last moment!

But in the thick of it, the beasts snatched Brannoch, leaving the damage to the halls our smallest concern! Everything we teach here is in peril if Brannoch is lost!

You must go where Brannoch was taken, north to the Gargoyle roost at Spire Crag! Bring Brannoch back or we are finished!

reminder.speaker: Captain
reminder.text: I'm sure Brannoch is in dreadful danger! Please hurry!

found.speaker: Brannoch
found.text: You there! Quickly, find some way to get me out of here! Maldrek was indeed the sorcerer behind the Gargoyle attack and he has dark plans for the Orrery of Zorreth. Unfortunately, I was taken with my mana spent and I haven't the strength to break out of here by myself. Maldrek laid a strong ward on these bars, ending all hope of casting my way out.

following.speaker: Brannoch
following.text: Let's get moving! There's no time to lose!

completion.speaker: Captain
completion.text:
In better times, the bells of Zorreth would ring all night for the return of Brannoch! Well done! But now we must stop the wicked Maldrek once and for all.

Please take these as tokens of our thanks for such a brave rescue!

journal.text: Go to Spire Crag and rescue Brannoch.

main_opening.specifics: Rector Ulbrin, sent word of by the Captain, wants his Book of Wards taken back from the Gargoyles in the Observatory.

herald.speaker: Fenn
herald.text: Make way! Rector Ulbrin wants to see you!

opening.speaker: Ulbrin
opening.text:
Welcome to Zorreth, brave Adventurer! The Captain told us to expect you!

The Gargoyles on the hill have gone mad! They swooped into the college and stole my Book of Wards! A student chased the dirty things into the Observatory, but has not come back.

Go to the Observatory east of here and take my book back from the Gargoyles. Come and see me when you are back. You will find me in my hall at the heart of the college.

reminder.speaker: Ulbrin
reminder.text: Those wretched Gargoyles are making too much mischief lately.

journal.text: Retrieve the Rector's Book of Wards from the Gargoyles.
